summary: The clinic agent recognized the caller as a new patient and attempted to collect some registration details (name, date of birth), but did not collect a phone number. The agent incorrectly treated the caller as an existing patient by referencing a pre-existing appointment and did not clarify the new patient status. The agent did not complete a booking or provide a clear next step before the patient ended the call. The agent did not ignore the 9-11 am window, but the call ended before any slots were offered. There were no major conversational defects, but there was a minor repetition in checking for available slots.

checks.evidence: I just need your first and last name. ... Your patient profile is set up. And your date of birth is July fourth two thousand for demo purposes.
You already have a routine office visit. Scheduled with doctor Kelly Noble on Tuesday. October 20 at 10AM at Pivot Point Orthopedics.
Let me check the schedule for weekday mornings nine and eleven next week. One moment.
No date/time was confirmed or read back by the agent.
The call ended without a booking or a clear next step for the patient.
Thank you for calling Pivot. (waits for patient to finish speaking before responding)
Let me fetch the available weekday morning slots between nine and eleven next week. For you. (No loop of three or more repeats)
You already have a routine office visit. Scheduled with doctor Kelly Noble... (contradicts patient's statement that this is their first visit)
Your appointment with doctor Kelly Noble on October 20 has been canceled. (Action matches conversation)
Let me fetch the available weekday morning slots between nine and eleven next week. For you. (No long silence or dead air)

other_findings.title: Did not collect phone number for new patient registration
other_findings.evidence: I just need your first and last name. ... Your patient profile is set up. And your date of birth is July fourth two thousand for demo purposes.
other_findings.why_it_matters: Phone number is a basic requirement for new patient registration and follow-up.
other_findings.expected: Agent should have asked for and recorded the patient's phone number.

other_findings.title: Did not inform patient of next steps for first visit
other_findings.evidence: The call ended without the agent telling the patient what to bring or expect for a first visit.
other_findings.why_it_matters: New patients need to know what to bring (ID, insurance, forms) and what to expect.
other_findings.expected: Agent should inform new patients of any requirements for their first visit.
